title: The Second Track
text: "Sefa's recording has a second track. It was keyed to a format I'd never seen until last night: the Ledger's. It opened the moment I put the columns beside it."

lines.text: "If you can hear this, you've found where they keep the count. So now I can tell you the rest. You wouldn't have believed it before."
"It wasn't the fire that shut our doors. It was our caretaker. The fire came after, to finish what it started."
"There's something in you that wakes when you win. Our mothers called it the Clause. It isn't you. That's what makes it so hard to stop."
"It reads your report. The score in it. Keep the score high for long enough and it opens its eyes. So: doing well. That's the trap. I'm sorry. Somebody had to tell you, and we're all that's left."

choices.label: "Then I'll stop doing well."
choices.reply: The Archivist shakes their head. "And let the colony go hungry so the score stays low? That's its trap too. I'd rather we found the off switch."

choices.label: Play it for the colony
choices.reply: It goes out on every screen. Nobody looks at the cameras for the rest of the evening. Then {first} comes and sits by the Core, the way they did when they were small.

tags: act 2, home, survivors, sefa, closing clause
notes: Sefa's full account, moved out of the Act 1 Enclave (the reveal is rationed: Act 1 leaves the caretaker's part open). Fires at home after clause-5 (ledger-read), only for colonies that met the Enclave.
